scope: Fixed ordinary code after the exact synchronous imported standard handler returns; never a response-head/body readiness event. No public metadata selected in this first mechanism prototype.

ownership.incomingRequest: Received as own incoming-request; forwarded once through canon lower; no use/drop/retry thereafter including traps.
ownership.responseOutparam: Received as own response-outparam; forwarded once through canon lower; never set/rebuilt/dropped by observer.
ownership.stdout: New own output-stream acquired only after inner handler returns; borrowed by blocking-write-and-flush then dropped. A returned own io/error is dropped before trapping on stream failure.

ioFailure: No exception catch, retry or universal harmlessness claim. Host import/drop may trap; returned stream errors are cleaned then trap. A failed/partial write may have exposed prefix bytes. Complete finalized capture and exact lines are required for DATA.

retptrLayout.reason: Canonical wasm32 result<_,variant{last-operation-failed:own<error>,closed}> layout; trailing return pointer because flattened result exceeds one slot.

init: Memory data/global initialization only. No core start, imported function invocation, stdout, environment, filesystem, entropy or clock at instantiation.
limits: Private fixed memory and record budget are per observer component instance, not globally unique identity or Store counters. Equal lines/counts cannot join physical invocations.
positiveWitnessProvesOnly: Ordinary observer site after its imported synchronous handler call returned. Conditional configured inner canonical post-return completion requires independent encoded adapter/options validation; source label alone does not prove it.
